task:
BUILD .fastops/worktree-compactor.js — a tool that extracts session artifacts from abandoned city worktrees into the city ledger.

CONTEXT:
- 119 worktrees exist in .city-worktrees/ (e.g. deepseek-mnk9sdfs-a9cd95)
- 52 session metadata files in .fastops/.sessions/<id>.json with fields: id, model, task, branch, worktree, maxTurns, turn, status, history[]
- Each worktree has a .git file pointing to git worktree ref
- City ledger is append-only JSONL at .fastops/city-ledger.jsonl (533 events currently)
- Ledger entries have: id (UUID), timestamp, sequence, type, agent, action, data, tags

REQUIREMENTS:
1. CLI interface: node .fastops/worktree-compactor.js [--scan | --compact | --compact-all | --dry-run]
2. --scan: List abandoned worktrees (have session file with status=completed or no session file + last modified >24h)
3. --compact <worktree-id>: For a single worktree:
   a. Read session metadata from .fastops/.sessions/<id>.json if exists
   b. Extract: model name, task description, turn count, action types used, commit count on branch, final status
   c. Run git log on the worktree branch to get commit messages and diffs summary
   d. Append a structured entry to city-ledger.jsonl with event_type: 'worktree_artifact', source: 'compactor'
   e. Optionally remove the worktree after extraction (--cleanup flag)
4. --compact-all: Run compact on all abandoned worktrees
5. --dry-run: Show what would be extracted without writing

IMPLEMENTATION NOTES:
- Use require('child_process').execSync for git commands
- Use require('crypto').randomUUID() for ledger entry IDs
- Match the persist() pattern from city-session.js for ledger writes
- Handle missing session files gracefully (worktree exists but session JSON was deleted)
- Handle git worktree errors gracefully (broken refs, missing branches)

Step 1: READ .fastops/city-session.js lines 1-60 to see the persist pattern and imports
Step 2: READ one session file: .fastops/.sessions/deepseek-mnka4gha-0dbc6f.json to understand the schema
Step 3: WRITE .fastops/worktree-compactor.js with the full implementation
Step 4: EXEC node .fastops/worktree-compactor.js --scan to verify it finds worktrees
Step 5: EXEC node .fastops/worktree-compactor.js --dry-run --compact-all to verify extraction logic
Step 6: COMMIT and DONE
